title: Credentials encrypted at rest, API keys hashed
goal: Store agency provider passwords and tokens encrypted and website API keys as one-way hashes, so a database copy does not hand out working credentials.
why: voip_settings provider_auth_token, provider_api_key_secret, twilio_auth_token, twilio_api_key_secret are plaintext (db/tenant-schema.ts ~1741-1749); master tenant_api_keys.api_key and webhook_log.api_key are plaintext (db/master-schema.ts ~230, ~243). ADR-001 reseller checklist and GDPR both require this.
steps: utils/crypto-box.ts per READINESS-PLAN 4.3: encryptSecret(env, plaintext, aad), decryptSecret(env, stored, aad) (accepts legacy plaintext without the enc: prefix and reports legacy=true), isEncrypted(v). Keys from env.CREDENTIALS_KEYS (JSON) and env.CREDENTIALS_ACTIVE_KEY_ID; missing keys -> throw CredentialsKeyMissing (callers return 503 CREDENTIALS_UNAVAILABLE). AAD = `${tenantId}:${table}.${column}`.

vitest.config.ts: add test-only CREDENTIALS_KEYS = {"t1": "<base64 of 32 fixed bytes>"} and CREDENTIALS_ACTIVE_KEY_ID = "t1". fix-stack does not need a key in single mode if decrypt tolerates plaintext, but add `--var CREDENTIALS_KEYS:...` only if a route fails without it (prefer not to touch fix-stack here; R103 owns it; if needed, note it as a request).

routes/voip.ts settings PUT: encrypt the four secret columns before writing; GET keeps masking. Every reader (voip-provider.ts createVoipProvider, voip-callbacks.ts loadSettings, twilio-voice.ts, plivo-voice.ts) decrypts through one function loadVoipSettings(env, db, tenantId).

Master 0014: rebuild tenant_api_keys as (id, tenant_id, name, key_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, key_prefix TEXT NOT NULL, is_active, created_at, last_used_at) copying rows with key_hash = hex(sha256(api_key)) is not computable in SQLite; instead add key_hash and key_prefix columns, then a one-time backend maintenance routine hashes existing keys (POST /api/v1/admin/maintenance/hash-api-keys, super admin, idempotent) and blanks api_key; inbound.ts looks up by key_hash = sha256(presented key) and falls back to plaintext match only while api_key is non-empty (legacy). webhook_log stores key_prefix instead of the key.
integrations.ts key creation: generate `tck_` + 32 random base62 chars, store hash + prefix (first 8), return the full key once; list shows the prefix only.

POST /api/v1/admin/maintenance/reencrypt (super admin): for each tenant (resolveTenantDb), re-encrypt voip secrets with the active key and encrypt legacy plaintext; returns counts; idempotent; cursor param for resumption.
tests: backend/test/crypto-box.test.ts: round trip; wrong AAD fails; tampered ciphertext fails; decrypt with an old key id after rotation works; legacy plaintext is returned with legacy=true; missing keys throw.

backend/test/credential-encryption.test.ts: saving VoIP settings stores enc:v1 values in D1 (read raw row) and the masked GET is unchanged; a provider call path decrypts (mock fetch to Twilio and assert the Basic auth header); a website form post with a valid key works via hash lookup and the raw key is not stored in webhook_log; reencrypt converts a planted plaintext row.
acceptance: `SELECT provider_auth_token FROM voip_settings` never returns plaintext after a save or reencrypt (test).
API keys are shown once and stored hashed (test).
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/voip-settings.spec.ts e2e/webhooks-integrations.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: CREDENTIALS_KEYS generated and stored as a Worker secret and in the owner's password manager; reencrypt run once after deploy.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.
WebCrypto AES-GCM returns ciphertext with the tag appended; keep it together in one base64url field.
Never log secrets or the decrypted value; log tenant id and column only.
